title: Control Resonant sells 1 million in 3 weeks 🔺
subject: controlresonant
description:
Have you played Control Resonant yet? 👇

Remedy Entertainment says Control Resonant passed 1 million copies sold in about three weeks after its September 24, 2026 launch, making it the fastest-selling game in the studio's 31-year history. Alan Wake 2 needed around two months to reach the same milestone.

Sources: Remedy Entertainment (Oct 15, 2026), PC Gamer (Oct 15, 2026), Destructoid (Oct 15, 2026), Push Square, Remedy launch announcement
Game footage © Remedy Entertainment.

scenes.text: One million copies in three weeks.
That's Control Resonant. It launched September 24 and is now the fastest-selling game in Remedy's 31-year history.
Alan Wake 2 needed around two months to hit the same number.
It's Remedy's first self-published release at this scale, and CEO Jean-Charles Gaudechon called it a very strong start.
You play Dylan Faden, searching a warped Manhattan for his missing sister Jesse.
Remedy's next business review lands November 3, and it should show what those sales earned.
